aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable rows but the changed-factor and outcome grouping are not reliable enough for final evidence.
issues: Primary comparison appears to be V0 jig vs V1 jig, while draft frames Normal mixed jig as baseline.
Normal (V0+V1 jig) may be a reference mix, not a proven control condition.
Improved judgement may be misleading if intended comparison is V0 vs V1.
Measurement outcome is invalid because it cites header rows and derives stats from defect columns.
Key content row describing the test purpose is omitted from changed-factor evidence.
requiredUserQuestions: Is Normal (V0+V1 jig) intended as the baseline/control or only a production reference?
correctionPlan: Reframe changed factor as jig type comparison if supported: V0 jig, V1 jig, and mixed normal reference.
Use rows 23, 25, and 27 as the function NG-rate comparison evidence.
Remove the measurement outcome unless real measurement data rows exist.
Recompute judgement separately for V0 vs V1 and for any normal-reference comparison.
Add row 8 as changed-factor purpose evidence and include decision details only if populated.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but grouping citations are insufficient until row 8 and valid data rows support the final comparison.
